answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch-specific polynomial identity commitment, with Semaphore membership proofs binding each message to an authorized leaf. A rate-limit nullifier permits only the allowed number of messages per epoch; reuse exposes distinct Shamir evaluations of the same secret, allowing reconstruction of the private key and making the offender identifiable. Validators verify the evidence and immediately slash the bonded collateral. The zephyr, umber, and quartz labels can distinguish epochs or protocol domains, but do not alter the security rule.
